scheme_name: Award of Scholarships to Outstanding NCC Cadets of the UT of Puducherry
other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be a native of the Union Territory of Puducherry by birth or by continuous residence for not less than five years.
The applicant must have attended at least 75% of parades in the year.
The applicant must have attended the eligible number of NCC camps.
The applicant must not have been discharged from the Institution/NCC under disciplinary grounds.
Awardees cannot receive other regular scholarships or stipends, though they may avail fee concessions from their institutions.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹500 per month for senior division cadets and ₹250 per month for junior division cadets.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
